In the absence of sufﬁcient evidence to derive an EAR and set an RDA in the ﬁrst DRI reviews for calcium, vitamin D, ﬂuoride,
ﬁber, and potassium, AIs were set at levels considered adequate to avoid deﬁciency. Sodium deﬁciency however is not a health
